item.title: Greg Newby, CEO of Project Gutenberg, has died
item.description:
📝 Newby was CEO of the Project Gutenberg Literary Archive Foundation for more than 20 years and, in that role, worked very closely with Distributed Proofreaders. Newby collaborated with Microsoft and MIT to produce the Project Gutenberg Open Audiobook Collection of AI-narrated audiobooks. Newby and his tireless leadership of Project Gutenberg was a close partner of Distributed Proofreaders and will be greatly missed here.
🔗 Read more: https://www.pgdp.net/wiki/In_Memoriam/gbnewby

item.title: Infracost (YC W21) Hiring First Dev Advocate to Shift FinOps Left
item.description:
📝 Infracost helps engineers see the cost of their code changes before any money has been spent - we sit in the engineering workflow, show the cost impact, and suggest optimizations. We’re hiring our first Developer Advocate to help more engineers discover and fall in love with Infracost. We enable them to proactively find and fix cloud cost issues before they hit production.
🔗 Read more: https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/infracost/jobs/NzwUQ7c-senior-developer-advocate
